title: Equality before the Law: Legal Judgment Consistency Analysis for Fairness
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything related to faith or religion. It measured legal judgment inconsistency based on demographic features like gender and geographical region.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith. Its analysis is focused on regional and gender inconsistency within the Chinese legal system.
